# mvstmt: hasBreak returns true for labeled break in switch case
mv F:/BEGIN/+0,/END/-0 New
-- x.go --
package p

var done bool

func F() {
	// BEGIN
	x := 1
outer:
	for {
		switch {
		case done:
			break outer
		default:
			println(x)
		}
	}
	// END
	println("after")
}
